title: Faster and Better LLMs via Latency-Aware Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Zili Wang、Tianyu Zhang、Haoli Bai、Lu Hou、Xianzhi Yu、Wulong Liu、Shiming Xiang、Lei Zhu（机构：中国科学院大学、中国科学院自动化研究所、华为诺亚方舟实验室）
paper_type_zh: 面向系统部署的测试时扩展研究（Findings of EMNLP 2025）
best_for_zh: 在服务级延迟约束下部署推理模型的读者。
one_line: Latency-aware TTS allocates parallel branches and speculative decoding capacity to maximize reasoning accuracy under a time limit.
延迟感知测试时扩展在固定时间内分配并行分支与推测解码能力，以提高推理准确率。
why: It shows that token-optimal inference strategies can be slower than concurrent alternatives at the same accuracy.
inclusion_reason: It allocates test-time computation under wall-clock latency, rather than treating generated token count as the only budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time scaling is usually compared by accuracy gained per generated token. That view is incomplete for an interactive system: sequential reasoning can use fewer tokens but decode them slowly, while multiple branches can exploit otherwise idle hardware and reach the same answer faster. A compute-optimal strategy is therefore not necessarily latency-optimal when a user or service has a wall-clock deadline.

The paper asks how to allocate inference computation when time, rather than tokens alone, is the binding budget. It separates two sources of concurrency: generating several candidate branches in parallel and accelerating successive tokens through speculative decoding. The practical target is an answer policy that chooses their balance for maximum accuracy before the latency deadline expires.

测试时扩展通常按每个生成词元带来的准确率收益比较。对交互系统而言，这种视角并不完整：串行推理可能使用更少词元却解码缓慢，而多个分支可利用原本闲置的硬件资源，更快达到相同答案。因此，当用户或服务具有实际时间期限时，计算最优策略不一定是延迟最优策略。

论文追问当时间而非单独的词元数成为约束预算时，如何分配推理计算。它分开两种并发来源：并行生成多个候选分支，以及通过推测解码加速连续词元。实际目标是选择二者的平衡，使准确率在延迟期限到达前最大化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is that token efficiency and throughput jointly determine quality under a time limit. In memory-bound autoregressive inference, modestly increasing the number of concurrent branches can raise hardware utilization with little immediate latency penalty. Conversely, speculative decoding can improve sequence-wise throughput so that longer reasoning becomes feasible within the same time budget.

The paper frames branch-wise parallelism and sequence-wise parallelism as competing uses of concurrency. Neither should be maximized blindly: more branches eventually have diminishing returns, and longer speculative drafts can push the system into a compute-bound regime. A latency-optimal scaling policy allocates both resources according to the model, task, and serving hardware rather than following a fixed token budget.

核心思想是，在时间限制下，词元效率与吞吐量共同决定质量。在受内存限制的自回归推理中，适度增加并发分支数可提高硬件利用率，而不会立刻带来很大延迟惩罚。相反，推测解码可改善序列方向吞吐量，使更长推理能在相同时间预算内完成。

论文把分支方向并行与序列方向并行视为对并发能力的竞争性使用。二者都不应盲目最大化：更多分支最终收益递减，更长推测草稿可能使系统转入计算受限状态。延迟最优扩展策略应根据模型、任务和服务硬件分配两类资源，而非遵从固定词元预算。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors evaluate sequential and parallel scaling under both token and wall-clock budgets on MATH-500, AIME24, AIME25, and GPQA-Diamond, across models from 3B to 32B parameters. Parallel scaling uses multiple reasoning branches and majority voting. Sequence-wise acceleration uses speculative decoding, whose draft length controls how many successive tokens can be proposed and verified concurrently.

They search over branch count and speculative draft length with a greedy procedure. At each step the procedure evaluates whether expanding branches or increasing draft length gives a larger accuracy benefit under the same time constraint, then continues only while the result improves. The record linking the method to deployment is explicit: branch configuration, draft configuration, latency, throughput, tokens, and benchmark correctness are jointly observed rather than reported in separate experiments.

作者在 MATH-500、AIME24、AIME25 和 GPQA-Diamond 上，以词元和实际时间两种预算评估串行与并行扩展，覆盖三十亿到三百二十亿参数模型。并行扩展使用多个推理分支和多数投票；序列方向加速使用推测解码，其草稿长度控制可并发提出并验证多少连续词元。

他们用贪心程序搜索分支数和推测草稿长度。每一步，程序评估在相同时间限制下扩展分支或增加草稿长度哪一个带来更大准确率收益，并仅在结果提升时继续。把方法连接到部署的记录是明确的：分支配置、草稿配置、延迟、吞吐量、词元与基准正确性被共同观察，而不是在彼此分离的实验中报告。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that a strategy with superior accuracy per token can be slower under small-batch serving. Its illustrative s1.1-32B experiment reaches similar accuracy with sequential scaling using nine times fewer tokens, yet parallel scaling reaches it with 1.6 times lower latency. This demonstrates why token count alone can misstate a real-time test-time scaling trade-off.

Across reported settings, the joint allocation can improve accuracy by up to 7.3 percent over single-parallelism baselines under a one-minute constraint; the paper reports a 32B model reaching 82.3 percent on MATH-500 within one minute and a 3B model reaching 72.4 percent within ten seconds. These are hardware- and configuration-sensitive results, but they provide direct evidence that concurrency configuration is part of inference-time scaling, not merely an implementation detail.

论文报告，在小批量服务下，每词元准确率更高的策略可能反而更慢。其 s1.1-32B 示意实验中，串行扩展以少九倍词元达到近似准确率，但并行扩展以低 1.6 倍的延迟达到它。这说明仅用词元数可能错误表述实时测试时扩展的取舍。

在报告设定中，联合分配可在一分钟限制下比单一并行方式的基线最多提高 7.3% 准确率；论文报告三百二十亿模型在一分钟内于 MATH-500 达到 82.3%，三十亿模型在十秒内达到 72.4%。这些结果依赖硬件和配置，但它们直接证明并发配置是推理时扩展的一部分，而不只是实现细节。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main novelty is to replace the usual token-only budget with a serving-time budget. This exposes a distinction hidden by compute-optimal comparisons: a long sequential trajectory may be economical in tokens but underuse a memory-bound accelerator, while several shorter branches can use concurrency to increase accuracy before the same deadline. The relevant frontier is therefore accuracy versus latency, not accuracy versus length alone.

The work also unifies branch generation and speculative decoding as two control variables in one allocation problem. Parallel branches move the accuracy curve upward by exploring alternatives; speculative decoding moves it left by reducing the time per generated sequence. Treating them jointly gives a systems-level selection policy for test-time reasoning rather than proposing either as an isolated acceleration trick.

主要新意是用服务时间预算替代通常只看词元的预算。这暴露了计算最优比较隐藏的区别：长串行轨迹在词元上可能经济，却会低效使用受内存限制的加速器；多个更短分支则可利用并发，在同一期限前提高准确率。因此，相关前沿是准确率对延迟，而不只是准确率对长度。

工作还把分支生成和推测解码统一为同一分配问题的两个控制变量。并行分支通过探索替代方案将准确率曲线上移；推测解码通过缩短每条序列的生成时间将曲线左移。共同处理二者为推理时推理提供系统级选择策略，而不是把任一个当作孤立的加速技巧。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Latency-optimal settings depend on accelerator memory bandwidth, batch size, model architecture, speculative-draft acceptance, serving stack, and network overhead; a configuration measured on one platform need not transfer. The method also uses majority voting for its parallel selection, so tasks requiring a stronger verifier may change the trade-off. Greedy search reduces configuration trials but does not guarantee a global optimum. Production use should include tail latency, queueing, energy, and monetary cost rather than treating one benchmark wall-clock measurement as the complete deployment objective.
延迟最优设定依赖加速器内存带宽、批量大小、模型架构、推测草稿接受率、服务栈和网络开销；一个平台上测得的配置不一定可迁移。方法还以多数投票进行并行选择，因此需要更强验证器的任务可能改变取舍。贪心搜索减少了配置试验，却不保证全局最优。生产使用还应纳入尾延迟、排队、能耗和货币成本，而不能把一次基准实际时间测量视为完整部署目标。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a reasoning service has a firm response-time service-level objective. Benchmark sequential reasoning, branch counts, speculative draft lengths, throughput, and accuracy on the actual hardware with the intended batch regime. Log p50 and p95 latency as well as tokens and correctness, then select configurations under a fixed time limit rather than comparing them only at equal token counts. The paper is particularly useful for avoiding a common deployment mistake: choosing a token-efficient long-thought method that loses to parallel exploration once wall-clock time matters.
当推理服务具有严格响应时间服务目标时，可使用这项工作。应在实际硬件和目标批量制度下基准测试串行推理、分支数、推测草稿长度、吞吐量和准确率；记录 p50、p95 延迟以及词元和正确性，再在固定时间限制下选择配置，而不只在相等词元数时比较。论文尤其有助于避免常见部署错误：选择一个词元高效的长思考方法，却在实际时间重要时输给并行探索。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the accuracy–latency curves alongside the accuracy–token curves. Inspect the hardware, batch size, decoding engine, speculative model, branch aggregation, and latency definition, because any of them can reverse a comparison. A reproduction should fix the task and wall-clock budget, sweep branch count and draft length, and report utilization plus tail latency. The most useful ablation removes one concurrency mechanism at a time; it reveals whether a claimed gain comes from more search diversity, faster sequential generation, or a hardware artifact.
应把准确率—延迟曲线与准确率—词元曲线放在一起读。需要检查硬件、批量大小、解码引擎、推测模型、分支聚合和延迟定义，因为其中任何一项都可能颠倒比较。复现应固定任务和实际时间预算，扫描分支数与草稿长度，并报告利用率与尾延迟。最有信息量的消融是每次移除一种并发机制；它能揭示收益来自更多搜索多样性、更快串行生成，还是硬件假象。
